title: An aqua regia-free chemical recovery and reprecipitation of Ir from IrOx catalysts: optimisation of the extraction efficiency using surface response methodology
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,1741-1750
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00038F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sarah Turnbull, Delphine Clauss, Vincent Martin, Jean-Pierre Magnin, Laetitia Dubau, Frédéric Maillard
This study introduces a microwave assisted aqua-regia-free recycling process for Ir from IrOx catalysts. The experimental Ir extraction efficiency measured is 83 ± 10%. The leached Ir solution was then precipitated to form ((NH4)2IrCl6).
